tasks.name: Project structure
tasks.description: Modular package layout for the engine.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Package imports; tests discoverable

tasks.name: Scene data format
tasks.description: JSON Schema for scenes, characters, cameras, animations, environment and render settings.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Schema describes the structure; examples follow it
tasks.notes: Rules JSON Schema cannot express (overlaps, clip names, unique ids, times inside the duration) are in scene.py

tasks.name: Scene validator
tasks.description: Validate scenes and report every error with its path.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Reports all problems; rejects overlaps, bad ids, out-of-range times

tasks.name: Timeline system
tasks.description: Duration, fps, frame times, keyframe tracks with linear, smooth and hold interpolation.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 5 s at 24 fps gives 120 frames; interpolation endpoints correct

tasks.name: Coordinate system
tasks.description: Z-up right-handed metres; yaw and pitch; look-at; Z-up to Y-up conversion.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Orthonormal basis; round trips exact; forward maps to -Z in Y-up

tasks.name: Camera mathematics
tasks.description: Orbit, pan, tilt, dolly, track, zoom and hold, chained in a CameraPath.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Orbit keeps radius and height; motions compose; overlaps rejected

tasks.name: Example scenes
tasks.description: MVP orbit with raised arm, dolly/pan/tilt/zoom, sideways track.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All examples validate; MVP camera starts 3 m away and orbits 90 degrees

tasks.name: Blender integration
tasks.description: Translate a scene file into Blender objects.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Blender scene created headless from the MVP scene
tasks.notes: Blender is not installed in the container. Ubuntu 24.04 apt package 'blender' is the candidate; needs approval

tasks.name: Camera animation in Blender
tasks.description: Keyframe a Blender camera from CameraPath samples.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Per-frame Blender camera matches sample_cameras within 1e-4 m
tasks.automated_test: Read back camera matrices and compare

tasks.name: Basic humanoid
tasks.description: Simple placeholder humanoid rig.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Rig has the bones needed for raise_right_arm

tasks.name: Character positioning
tasks.description: Set character location and yaw from scene files.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: World position and yaw match the scene

tasks.name: Animation timeline
tasks.description: Apply clips such as raise_right_arm at given times.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Right arm is at rest at 2 s and raised at 4 s

tasks.name: Preview rendering
tasks.description: Low-resolution Blender preview without AI.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Video length equals scene duration; frame count equals timeline

tasks.name: Control passes
tasks.description: Export depth, normal, segmentation and pose where supported.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Depth matches scene distance on a test plane within tolerance
tasks.automated_test: Render a known plane and compare depth

tasks.name: Natural-language parser
tasks.description: Map instructions to scene data.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Rule parser turns the MVP sentence into the MVP scene

tasks.name: Instruction classification
tasks.description: Split instructions into camera, character, motion, environment, lighting, style, timing.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Each MVP clause gets the right category

tasks.name: Animation library
tasks.description: Reusable movements (idle, walk, raise arm) with timing.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Each clip loads and validates
tasks.automated_test: Load every clip; check duration and joint ranges

tasks.name: Pose sequences
tasks.description: Convert skeletal animation to per-frame pose conditioning (OpenPose or DWPose format).
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Wrist height rises in the expected frames
tasks.automated_test: Compare wrist height vs frame time

tasks.name: Video-model interface
tasks.description: Pluggable backend interface.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Dry run writes a manifest without calling a model
tasks.automated_test: Unit test with the dry-run backend

tasks.name: First controlled generation
tasks.description: One video from a scene with one control method.
required_technologies: Wan2.1 or VACE on the GPU host (tranklena over ssh)
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Clip runs end to end on the GPU host and has the right frame count
tasks.automated_test: Run on the GPU host; measure pose error on generated frames
tasks.notes: Needs the GPU host and model weights. This container has no GPU and no ComfyUI

tasks.name: Reproducibility record
tasks.description: Seed, model version, config, inputs and software versions saved with each run.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Re-running with the same record reproduces the same inputs and seed

tasks.name: Multiple conditioning methods
tasks.description: Combine pose, depth and segmentation.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Each signal changes the output in the expected direction

tasks.name: Camera and character sync
tasks.description: Poses and camera refer to one 3D scene.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Projected keypoints match the rendered character in the camera view

tasks.name: Identity preservation
tasks.description: Reference-image conditioning for the same character.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Face embedding similarity stays above a set threshold
tasks.automated_test: Face embedding distance over repeated seeds

tasks.name: Multiple characters
tasks.description: Two or more independently animated characters.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Each character follows its own keyframes

tasks.name: Object interactions
tasks.description: Pick up, open, sit, hand over objects.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Object stays with the hand within a few mm
tasks.automated_test: Readback of object and hand positions

tasks.name: Automated evaluation
tasks.description: Measure adherence to the requested scene.
required_technologies: pose estimator, depth estimator, face embedding
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Known-good clips rank above known-bad clips

tasks.name: Benchmarking
tasks.description: Compare text-only with each conditioning method across seeds.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Results include seeds, counts and failures
tasks.automated_test: Re-run the benchmark and check the table

tasks.name: Error detection
tasks.description: Find wrong poses, camera angles, identity changes, timing and spatial errors.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Detector flags a planted error of each type

tasks.name: Automatic correction
tasks.description: Map each error to a parameter change.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Each correction moves its metric in the intended direction

tasks.name: Iterative regeneration
tasks.description: Regenerate failed segments automatically.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Retries stop at the limit and keep the best result

tasks.name: Multi-shot continuity
tasks.description: Keep characters and environment consistent across shots.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Continuity score reported per shot pair

tasks.name: Adaptive control selection
tasks.description: Pick the most reliable method per instruction, from benchmark results.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Selection beats a fixed method on a held-out set

tasks.name: Performance optimisation
tasks.description: Speed, VRAM, caching and scheduling.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Each change shows a measured gain and no quality loss

tasks.name: Filmmaking interface
tasks.description: Build, preview, generate and edit scenes from a UI.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: User can create the MVP scene and preview it
